title: What the Kernel is told about required Lenses, Roles and limits.

deterministic.description: Each deterministic Lens: its name, the exact name of the check run GitHub reports for it, and the id of the one App whose check it is read from. tools/check_authority.py refuses a Lens or a check named twice

check.description: The check run's name exactly as GitHub reports it. The Kernel matches a check in the facts to this Lens by its name, exactly, never by the Lens's own name

workflow.description: For a Lens GitHub Actions runs, the path of its workflow file; null for a Lens no workflow runs. GitHub Actions is one App for every job in the repo, one a pull request adds among them, so a check under the Lens's name from any other path is not the Lens's. The pin is to the path, not to what the file says. tools/check_workflows.py refuses null for a Lens whose App is GitHub Actions, and holds the file to running the Lens's check

status_on_item.description: The one name of the check run the Controller posts as the status on the item. tools/check_authority.py refuses a required Lens's name: the status would speak for that Lens

check_conclusions.description: What each conclusion GitHub gives a required check means, by its own name. A conclusion the map does not name is unreadable. Only success passes: any other name maps to failing, pending or unreadable.

max_path_length.description: The longest path of a workflow file a Decision's evidence shows. A longer one, or one not in the form a Lens's workflow takes, is shown as unreadable
